summary: Consume body bytes into a fresh ArrayBuffer or Uint8Array for arrayBuffer()/bytes().
caveats: bytes() availability depends on target Web API version; when supported it must not be emulated with a shared view over mutable internal storage.

tests.name: arrayBuffer returns bytes
tests.input: const r=new Response("A"); const b=new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer()); console.log(b.length,b[0]);

tests.name: bytes returns Uint8Array when supported
tests.input: const r=new Response("AB"); const b=await r.bytes(); console.log(b instanceof Uint8Array,b.length,b[1]);
